**Surfaced 2026-05-16 by Arc 27 PLINY in QA-invite on stoa--32b.3.**

Arc 27's PR #7 squash unintentionally absorbed 7 pre-existing housekeeping commits because arc-27/build was branched off local main while local main was 7 commits ahead of origin/main (housekeeping landed earlier same day: sector-4 registry, gitignore narrow, the-stoa install of MISSING files, retro doc, arc-23/24/25 design tracking, arc-26 paste tracking).

Result: PR #7 squash contains 23 files instead of the 5 intended for the arc. NOT a defect — all bundled content is legitimate prior work that needed to land anyway. But it muddies the PR scope, makes review harder, and means the squash commit subject doesn't accurately describe the scope.

## The discipline (proposed)

Before any arc-build branch creation, PLINY should:
1. `cd <workspace> && git fetch origin main && git status`
2. If local main is ahead of origin/main: `git push origin main` (or land the pre-existing commits via a PR FIRST, depending on whether they're substrate-canonical changes)
3. THEN `git checkout -b arc-N/build` from current main

Alternatively: PLINY could branch from origin/main directly (`git checkout -b arc-N/build origin/main`), but that risks the build session being unaware of the unpushed local-main commits and re-doing them.

The right shape is probably: PLINY's activation paste or MAJOR_PLINY.md §X reminds PLINY to verify origin sync at branch-creation time.

## Why P3

Not blocking — arcs ship cleanly even with the bundle. But future arcs benefit from the discipline; defer cost compounds (every arc that hits this pattern has the same scope-muddied PR).

## Cross-refs

- stoa--32b.3 (Arc 27 ticket where this surfaced)
- the-stoa commit 2f78323 (Arc 27 squash; the empirical anchor for the bundling)
- MAJOR_PLINY.md (likely home for the discipline addition)

## Why now

N=2 bit-by-it today (PR #46 multi-project routine + PR #8 Arc 28) + N=1 worked-when-applied today (Arc 29 shipped clean because the pre-branch check was baked into the activation paste). Discipline provably works when applied; substrate canon encoding it means every future arc gets it without paste-reminders.

## The rule (PRINCIPAL-articulated 2026-05-17)

Before PLINY creates a new arc-build branch (e.g., `arc-N/build`), two pre-branch checks:

1. **No other arc-build branch hanging around** — the prior arc's branch must be merged AND deleted before a new one is created. (Per PRINCIPAL: 'at most one team working on a repo at any one time'; PLINY may have at most ONE arc-build branch in flight.)
2. **Local main = origin/main** — no unpushed commits. `git fetch origin main && git log --oneline main..origin/main` AND `git log --oneline origin/main..main` both empty.

If either check fails: PLINY pauses + surfaces to user-tier POLYBIUS (or PRINCIPAL via [for: PRINCIPAL] tag) with the specific state + asks for adjudication ('push the unpushed commits first? discard them? wait?'). Does NOT silently proceed with local-ahead state inherited into the arc branch.

## What this fixes

The bundled-squash pattern observed today twice:
- PR #46 squash absorbed 7 pre-existing commits' content (intent was multi-project routine; ended up with 23 files instead of 5)
- PR #8 squash absorbed similar (intent was Arc 28; pre-existing housekeeping bundled)

Result: PR scope ballooned beyond arc scope; squash commit message had wrong leading line; future POLYBIUSes reading git history get a muddier picture of what each arc accomplished. Pure hygiene + reviewability problem, not a correctness regression, but the substrate-readability cost compounds.

## Where it lives (substrate canon)

- MAJOR_PLINY.md — new discipline section encoding the two-check pre-branch rule
- Activation paste convention — reminder included alongside cron-hygiene step (the pattern Arc 29 pastes used + worked)
- Possibly operating-disciplines.md — universal-team framing if other seats ever create branches

## Empirical lineage to cite in encoding

- N=2 bit-by-it: PR #46 (multi-project routine) + PR #8 (Arc 28) — both absorbed pre-existing local commits
- N=1 worked-when-applied: Arc 29 (stoa--ads) — pre-branch hygiene check in activation paste resulted in clean ship; first arc this session without the symptom
